chain: TileEntityFluidTank constructs one FluidInventorySlot.input and output slot. Each server tick inputSlot.handleTank uses restored editMode; enum edit mode defaults BOTH. Mode-change API resets last direction then marks tile for save.

Tile disk load/save reaches TileEntityMekanism loop over registered ContainerType.TYPES. AbstractContainerType registers ITEM; canHandle/persists selects actual inventory. ItemContainerType maps tile inventory; IListContainerType writes indexed nonempty per-slot serialized children and restores valid nonnegative byte indices by virtual deserialize.

ResourceHandlerSlot serializes/deserializes base item contents then owned direction journal. UNKNOWN omitted; optional failed/missing direction defaults UNKNOWN. Stock uses IInventorySlot ITEM_HELPER -> nonnegative amount codec and readOrEmpty -> unchecked setContents rather than type validator.

ResourceHandlerSlot.handleContainer chooses FILL/EMPTY/BOTH. In BOTH UNKNOWN first attempts tank-to-item; after failure switches to item-to-tank or output movement. Saved FILL_FROM_ITEM continues inbound, saved DRAIN_INTO_ITEM continues outbound without automatically ejecting a possible voiding container.

Direction updates participate in SnapshotJournal snapshots when a transaction is supplied; revert method restores direction. Fill/drain helper simulates destination/source acceptance then performs matched amount transfer in nested transaction, commits only if both amounts match. Actual NeoForge transaction engine not independently read.

InOutSlotResourceItemAccess.insert routes transformed container item back to input if saved direction and simulated remaining capacity/contents permit continued processing, otherwise output. Simulation transaction is not committed; actual slot insertion uses supplied transaction. Nonempty input uses input then output fallback.

BaseResourceContainer updates snapshot for transaction and notifies contents listener on root commit; no-transaction setContents immediately notifies. ResourceHandlerSlot emptiness callback resets direction. ResourceHandlerSlot.copyContents preserves journal when copying actual ResourceHandlerSlot; tank upgrade path calls it.

Item representation path is narrower: ResourceContainerType.attachedCopyOf stores stacks only; copyToContainers calls setContents, not ResourceHandlerSlot.copyContents. Source TODO explicitly says direction no longer persists when breaking blocks. Mode component alone does not preserve journal.
static_limits: One complete concrete fluid-slot resume/routing mechanism; shared generic journal/codec/helper and each mode/fill/drain overload give0 separate credit. No extra credit for one more enum decoder.
Unknown/missing/invalid enum falls back UNKNOWN. This can change preferred processing direction, so no lossless unknown payload promise. No persisted opaque field quarantine.

IListContainerType ignores out-of-range IDs, permits duplicate valid IDs last read wins, and does not clear omitted live slots; repeated-load replacement/idempotence not guaranteed. Byte indexing practical upper bound retained.
